items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: It's Lou Jones on trumpet; Walter Phatz Morris on trombone and harmonica; Teddy Mc Cain on tenor sax. >> [INTERVIEWER] Beau McCain, yeah.

ctx.x: You have one group listed here. This is after you made 'Topsy' and it looks like it was probably a working band. It's Lou Jones on trumpet; Walter Phatz Morris on trombone and harmonica; Teddy Mc Cain on tenor sax.
June Cole on piano. Dicky Thompson on guitar. Pete Compo on bass.
